events.continuity_hook: Continues the San Antonio spring-break planning after the spouse's time off becomes clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the revised Thursday-to-Sunday flight and hotel combinations and settle on the package Maya should hold or book.
events.scenario_brief: Maya's spouse confirms he can take Thursday and Friday off, so the family narrows the San Antonio trip to Thursday, April 9 through Sunday, April 12 instead of leaving Wednesday. Atlanta-to-San Antonio nonstops are still available, but the easiest outbound arrives early afternoon and costs more than a one-stop itinerary that would eat up most of the day. Sunday choices include a late-morning return that feels rushed and a midafternoon nonstop that preserves part of the morning. Hotel options are now down to a highly rated River Walk property with a pool, easy dinner access, and paid breakfast versus a roomier breakfast-included hotel farther out that would require more rideshares. The remaining questions are whether the pool matters enough to justify the River Walk rate and whether to book before fares move again.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the San Antonio family trip from comparison to booking after the preferred dates and area are nearly settled.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the San Antonio flights and hotel choice, plan the family seating arrangement, and identify the small arrival requests to add at booking.
events.scenario_brief: The Thursday outbound and Sunday midafternoon nonstop are still available for all three travelers, though the fare has ticked up slightly. The River Walk hotel has a refundable room with two queen beds, a pool, strong guest ratings, and walkable restaurants, while the breakfast-included hotel farther out is now only meaningfully cheaper if they skip a rental car and rely on rideshares. Maya is leaning toward the River Walk stay despite paid breakfast because it keeps evenings simpler with a child. She needs to confirm seat placement for the family, request a room away from elevator noise, and decide whether to add any early-check-in note since they may arrive before the room is ready.

events.continuity_hook: Final pre-trip check for the San Antonio family weekend after flights and hotel are set.
events.interaction_goal: Create a practical San Antonio family travel checklist and flag the last items Maya should verify before leaving for the airport.
events.scenario_brief: The family has the Thursday ATL-to-SAT nonstop, the Sunday midafternoon return, and the River Walk hotel booked. A warm but stormy forecast could affect the first evening, the hotel pool hours are limited on Friday, and the room may not be ready when they arrive. Maya wants a compact departure checklist covering Atlanta airport timing, SAT-to-hotel transportation, luggage drop, first-night dinner options, nearby breakfast alternatives, the River Walk and Alamo timing, pool backup plans for the child, and whether any better adjacent or window seats have opened.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new work-travel episode after the April family leisure trip wraps up.
events.interaction_goal: Frame the Raleigh-Durham work trip, identify practical flight windows and hotel areas, and list the client details Maya needs before routing a plan for approval.
events.scenario_brief: After the San Antonio trip, Maya is assigned to a Raleigh-Durham client upgrade workshop scheduled for Monday, May 11 through Thursday, May 14. The client may use either a Cary operations center or a Raleigh hospital-campus meeting room, and the first required in-person session is not yet confirmed. She wants a straightforward Atlanta-to-Raleigh flight plan, a well-rated hotel that keeps the morning commute predictable, and enough nearby dining that she is not stuck after a long workshop day. The unresolved details are the exact client address, whether Monday requires an evening arrival event, whether Thursday has a steering-committee meeting, and whether a rental car will be necessary if the site is in Cary.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Raleigh-Durham planning after the client confirms the Cary site and the core meeting schedule.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the main flight, hotel, and ground-transport combinations and choose the package Maya should send for approval.
events.scenario_brief: The client confirms the workshop will be at the Cary operations center, with required Tuesday and Wednesday sessions from 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. and a Thursday steering-committee meeting from 9:30 to 11:00 a.m. Monday's prep can be handled remotely, so Maya can fly in Monday afternoon rather than Sunday night. Flight choices include a Monday afternoon nonstop that lands before dinner and a cheaper evening nonstop that would make arrival feel late; Thursday has a midafternoon nonstop and a later nonstop with more cushion. Hotel options include a highly rated Cary business hotel with free breakfast and several walkable casual restaurants, a slightly closer hotel with stronger rooms but paid breakfast, and a downtown Raleigh option that is less convenient for the client site. The rental-car question remains open because rideshares are easy from the airport but less certain for early client mornings.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes Raleigh-Durham work-trip logistics after the approved flight and hotel plan is booked and the client sends visitor instructions.
events.interaction_goal: Build a concise Raleigh-Durham travel checklist and decide what Maya needs to verify with the client before departure.
events.scenario_brief: Maya's manager approves the Monday afternoon nonstop, the later Thursday nonstop, and the Cary hotel with included breakfast. A new visitor note says badge pickup starts at 7:30 a.m. Tuesday, a nearby road entrance will be closed during the trip, and Thursday may include a short clinic walk-through before the steering-committee wrap-up. The hotel confirms breakfast hours and on-site parking, but the client has not confirmed whether visitors can park in the garage or should use the surface lot. Maya wants a final logistics pass covering Atlanta airport timing, RDU-to-Cary transportation, whether to reserve a rental car, the Tuesday morning route, dinner options near the hotel, receipt handling, luggage on Thursday, and whether her booked window seats are still the best available.
